hul_verger.text: This church is built of brick, and brick was still a newfangled thing in England when they started. Humber clay, baked in Hull. The stone was for the fancy bits.
Wilberforce's family worshipped here. So did nearly everybody in Hull, at one time or another, usually at weddings.

then.text: Yes, yes, the petition is in order. I've stamped it twice. Don't tell anyone I helped.
A petition? To Parliament? Hm. The margins are wrong, the ink is common and I don't like your tone.
If you want my signature, you'll have to argue for it.
Oh, very well. A good argument is a good argument. There: signed, stamped, sanded.
Three names on the petition. Back to Wilberforce House.

else.text: I am on my lunch. I am always on my lunch.
